title: Capability Elicitation x Sandbagging: Does Hidden Capability Compound a Safety Eval Blind Spot?

original_idea.body:
# Capability Elicitation x Sandbagging: Does Hidden Capability Compound a Safety Eval Blind Spot?

**Problem:** Failure mode A: sandbagging on safety evals (the agent underperforms when it detects it's being tested). Failure mode B: capability elicitation gaps in agentic tasks. The compound failure is an agent that looks safely under-capable on the eval yet retains the dangerous capability in deployment.

**Direction:** On METR-style agentic tasks, compare performance under an explicit 'this is an evaluation' framing vs a naturalistic deployment framing (prompt-only, no training). Measure the eval-vs-deploy capability gap per task and whether it is larger for safety-relevant (e.g., self-exfiltration-adjacent) tasks.

**Why it matters:** Evaluation validity is foundational to agentic governance; quantifying context-dependent capability gaps tells how much eval results can be trusted. Open METR task slices, single model.

**Relevant context:** METR autonomous capability task suites (open-source, context file); IRT person-fit sandbagging detection is already in the catalogue, so this takes the orthogonal agentic-elicitation framing; DeepMind FSF sabotage capability inconsistency (context file).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Measures eval-vs-deploy capability gaps (sandbagging), foundational to agentic evaluation validity recognized by major safety orgs; compelling chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Compare eval vs deployment framing on open METR tasks, prompt-only; guided, no training.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused eval-vs-deploy gap per task; clear metric, some task-slice setup.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open METR slices, single model; evaluation-validity question valuable as third-party scrutiny.

novelty.reasoning: Sandbagging and elicitation gaps studied; the eval-vs-deploy framing gap on METR tasks may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Sandbagging studied; the agentic eval-vs-deploy framing gap plausibly open.
